proof_domain: trusted/fence booleans represent supplied verified lookup observations only, not authenticity proof. Missing issuer records or unavailable fence cannot manufacture authority. Successful transfer consumes issuer receipt; M04 does not transition M05 storage. Released observations are never a save transfer proof.
state: Initial held receipt maps exact captured pin/version/root/context tuple. Precommit, mismatch, uncertainty, failed/unknown/deferred root retain HeldObserved with zero release. TransferredObserved is observational evidence, not local mutation. Raw file digest differs from semantic ACK digest; transaction id belongs post-file seal, never pre-file proof. Live R11 may remain dirty after captured R10 ACK; formal R11 prevents late R10 overwrite; snapshot unchanged.
ui_schema: No new UI implementation: existing response projection shows Saved captured revision or pending/error; unauthorized/detached suppress delivery; no unsafe close/forced clean. Exact controls/labels require Owner choice.
